sloka: कदा नु राक्षस इन्द्रस्य निधाय उरसि सायकान् ।सीताम् प्रत्याहरिष्यामि शोकम् उत्सृज्य मानसम् ॥६-५-१९॥।।
transliteration: kadā nu rākṣasa indrasya nidhāya urasi sāyakān ।sītām pratyāhariṣyāmi śokam utsṛjya mānasam ॥6-5-19॥।।

translations.english: Indeed by shooting arrows into the chest of rakshasa king, when will I get back Sita and cast off grief from my mind.
